To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the apparent mean yield pressure from the Heckel plot is not constant but is affected by the applied compaction pressure, particle yield strength and strain hardening of the material.
the apparent mean yield pressure of materials with viscoelastic and plastic deformation behavior is affected by the applied compaction pressure and the rate of change in pressure.
the Heckel parameter is not a constant for a given material and is affected by the compaction pressure, particle yield strength and strain hardening of a material.

understanding the effect of varying compaction pressures on the Heckel parameters.

the Heckel parameter is pressure dependent and the Heckel plot does not give the true yield pressure.
